metadata.title: Beyond the Headline Count
metadata.annotationMethod: Prepared fictional editorial annotations; no automated or live AI judgments.

campaigns.name: Signal / podcast
campaigns.purpose: Launch Signal, a podcast about the people shaping neighborhood sound.
campaigns.audience: Curious listeners seeking locally rooted audio storytelling
campaigns.primaryMessage: Signal pairs local voices with practical listening guides to help listeners explore their own neighborhoods.

campaigns.name: Frame / streaming showcase
campaigns.purpose: Introduce Frame, a streaming showcase of independent regional films.
campaigns.audience: Film enthusiasts who want context from independent creators
campaigns.primaryMessage: Frame pairs independent regional films with filmmaker conversations that reveal how each story was made.

campaigns.name: Folio / digital magazine
campaigns.purpose: Launch Folio, a digital magazine series examining everyday civic spaces.
campaigns.audience: Thoughtful readers looking for accessible local civic reporting
campaigns.primaryMessage: Folio combines reported stories about civic spaces with open reading guides for community discussion.

outlets.name: Civic Loom
outlets.audience: Readers interested in local civic life
